scope: returning-append Option A (A1) chunk-boundary yield hub CPU tests (test_append_yield.py); no box, VM or GPU evidence

leaves.name: native-transaction-rig
leaves.replaces: A served engine running the ~40k bulk native prefill (41 chunks) and a short native append on the split route (PP2xTP2, four ranks)
leaves.equivalence: Inherited from returning_append_fixture_leaves.json and used as is: test_e3_native_overlap.cold_stack gives the real PrefillAdmissionController, NativeSegmentDriver, GraphRouter/route controllers and four real bridge/dispatcher workers. The yield reads only states this rig has: the retained worker row, the typed all-rank CancelRequest and its CancelAcks, the parked chunk, the terminal commit, the FULL transition acks and the armed intent. A 3-chunk bulk reaches every boundary branch a 41-chunk bulk does.
leaves.cannot_prove: Chunk timing, CUDA work, decode stalls, the real 0.77 s/chunk

leaves.name: pause-state-enum
leaves.replaces: vllm.v1.core.sched PauseState (the enum AutoArmPolicy reads as type(old_pause).PAUSED_ALL)
leaves.equivalence: A str Enum with UNPAUSED and PAUSED_ALL that compares equal to the rig's pause strings, so core_for's set_pause_state and the policy's type(old_pause).PAUSED_ALL both work unchanged.
leaves.cannot_prove: Other pause modes (the policy only uses these two)

leaves.name: request-object
leaves.replaces: The pinned vllm Request of the bulk, the returning append and other held requests
leaves.equivalence: test_append_yield.Req extends the reviewed test_e3_admission_native.Request with exactly the fields the candidate rule, _reentry_plan and _reentry_cohort read (status.name, num_output_tokens, num_preemptions, num_prompt_tokens, resumable, is_prefill_chunk, lora/pooling/structured/ec params, sampling_params logprobs). Every refusal branch is driven field by field in Candidate.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real token ids and sampling

leaves.name: per-request-prefix-hit
leaves.replaces: KVCacheManager.get_computed_blocks over the real prefix cache (the append's 107,184-token hit on the box)
leaves.equivalence: Returns (blocks, cached tokens, shared) per request id, the triple the candidate rule and the admission read; the lookup is recorded so a reopen from a fresh lookup is visible (Codex 3).
leaves.cannot_prove: The real prefix hit; the box records cached tokens per request

leaves.name: kv-free
leaves.replaces: KVCacheManager.free (kv_cache_manager.py:603)
leaves.equivalence: Returns the request's block ids to the reviewed BlockPool.freed list and drops its row: the effect the close-frees mutant must make visible (Codex 1).
leaves.cannot_prove: Allocator internals (ref counts, the free queue order)

leaves.name: stock-handback
leaves.replaces: The stock schedule step that, on FULL, schedules the append's last prompt token and samples its first output token, and the worker-side add_request
leaves.equivalence: Scheduler side: the request moves from waiting to running with num_output_tokens 1 and its prompt computed. Worker side: each rank's req_states gains a row whose prefill is complete, so the real live_census counts it as a live decode. These are the only fields append_yield_handback_done, _reentry_cohort and the barrier/identity proofs read.
leaves.cannot_prove: The sampled token, decode numerics

leaves.name: stock-finish-and-abort
leaves.replaces: Scheduler.finish_requests (ABORTED) after executor_hooks.before_abort returned, as EngineCore orders them
leaves.equivalence: The request leaves its queue, running, scheduler.requests and every worker row; its blocks are freed. executor_hooks.before_abort itself is the real seam and decides whether the driver stops.
leaves.cannot_prove: Client transport timing

leaves.name: auto-arm-decode-capability
leaves.replaces: native_auto_arm.worker_capability under FLASH_S5_AUTO_ARM=1 (stock cudagraph dispatch against the captured decode-split bank)
leaves.equivalence: The supported cohort counts 1-4 are given (the counts the box proved at alpha-next); engine epoch, route generation (router._transition_seq) and storage epoch are the worker's own. auto-arm's identity proof reads exactly this record.
leaves.cannot_prove: That the captured graph exists for a count, or runs correctly with the joined append (box)

leaves.name: construction-inventory
leaves.replaces: native_startup.NativeStartup.inventory() and its lane_state decode owner
leaves.equivalence: Only the fields the identity row reads (route, generation, storage epoch, worker rank, incarnation), each taken from the worker's real WorkerState, GraphRouter and route controller.
leaves.cannot_prove: Bank/communicator byte measurements

leaves.name: policy-tick-order
leaves.replaces: executor_hooks: one AutoArmPolicy.tick per EngineCore step, then the driver's advance, with control replies settled by the transport
leaves.equivalence: Rig.tick calls p.tick(), d.advance() and the workers' completions in that order; the policy's own phases (drain, barrier, identity, split, arm) run unmodified.
leaves.cannot_prove: Wall-clock gaps between steps

leaves.name: scheduler-select-fields
leaves.replaces: The pinned Scheduler.policy and VllmConfig fields AutoArmPolicy._select reads
leaves.equivalence: FCFS policy, data_parallel_size 1, no speculative config: the production settings. Only reached after a mutant sends the bulk to stock.
leaves.cannot_prove: Other policies (refused by _select anyway)

leaves.name: align-world
leaves.replaces: The worker's Mamba align kernels and stock model-state registration around a native chunk (mamba_utils preprocess/precopy/postprocess, MambaHybridModelState.add_request, RequestState add/remove)
leaves.equivalence: The real LaneChunkFactory, LaneAlign, LaneTables and LaneChunk over test_e3_lane_chunk's reviewed fake runner. The kernels are their pinned arithmetic, one request: preprocess (:534-548), precopy (copy src_col -> state_idx when src_col >= 0 and they differ, :604-610), postprocess under PRECOMPUTED_NEW_COMPUTED, add_request (accepted = 1, state_idx = (num_computed - 1) // block_size, :115-123). The slot is freed on release and reused on the next registration.
leaves.cannot_prove: Kernel numerics, the 4,048-token block (the rig uses 4), GDN layer state contents

leaves.name: forward-state-model
leaves.replaces: The GDN layers' read of the running SSM/conv state at column state_idx of the lane table row and their write of the state at chunk_end
leaves.equivalence: A block's state is the token count folded into it; a chunk [s, e) must read s and writes e. A block another request rewrites, or a reopen from a wrong start, shows as a wrong read (both mutants in RealBuilderState).
leaves.cannot_prove: Numerical equality of states (token identity is the VM/box proof)

leaves.name: frozen-tree-subprocess
leaves.replaces: The pre-build engine (BASE_COMMIT f3951ee0) running the same scenario
leaves.equivalence: A child interpreter pre-imports the six changed engine files from BASE_COMMIT (git show), then runs frozen_scenario over the same unchanged harness rig; journals (clocks and incarnations removed), admission records, hold decisions, queues and route are compared with this tree's run.
leaves.cannot_prove: Paths the scenario does not visit; skips where git or the base commit is unavailable

leaves.name: source-mutants
leaves.replaces: A hand-edited engine with one defect
leaves.equivalence: Each mutant recompiles one function from its own source with one or two exact edits (each must match once) in its module's globals and patches it in for one check.
leaves.cannot_prove: Defects outside the named edits

leaves.name: deferred-cancel-ack
leaves.replaces: A rank whose retained row is still draining when the first close round arrives
leaves.equivalence: Rank 3 answers the first round with a valid wire_v1.CancelAck (disposition accepted, not released); later rounds reach its real bridge cancel. The driver's own ack handling decides.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real drain timing on a rank

leaves.name: bulk-block-allocator
leaves.replaces: An allocator defect handing the append blocks the bulk holds
leaves.equivalence: allocate_slots for the append returns the bulk's block ids: fault injection the engine guard must refuse (Codex 2).
leaves.cannot_prove: How such a defect could arise

leaves.name: startup-enabled
leaves.replaces: s5_startup._enabled over the overlap composition settings
leaves.equivalence: As test_e3_native_layer_groups.Startup: patched true so the launch guards that follow it are reached with only the yield settings varied.
leaves.cannot_prove: The overlap composition's own settings checks

leaves.name: staged-direct-transport
leaves.replaces: The owned ReplyTransport plus the generated worker loop (executor_hooks.worker_rpc -> stage_wire.stage_rpc, worker_handle_output) for FLASH_S5_STAGE_LOCAL=1 stage-scoped broadcasts
leaves.equivalence: test_e3_r4_worker_bridge.DirectTransport with the one stage-local rule: every rank executes the broadcast through the real worker_rpc; a rank outside the StageScoped ranks returns STAGE_SKIP and writes no reply; only the scope's ranks (or the targeted output rank) answer and are expected. Unscoped commands keep the base rule. The driver is the real StagedSegmentDriver (s5_startup.py:378-381 selection), staged progress selected.
leaves.cannot_prove: Pickling over the MQ, reply-thread timing, per-rank ring lag (test_e3_stage_local's RingStack proves those for the staged driver)

leaves.name: staged-ring-metadata
leaves.replaces: The rpc_broadcast_mq ring metadata StagedSegmentDriver._check_headroom reads (ring_has_headroom over BoundedSender.queue)
leaves.equivalence: stage_net.FakeRing (declared in stage_fixture_leaves.json) attached to the rig's bounded sender and never written: every slot writable, so the headroom check passes as on an idle ring; the reserve itself and a full ring are test_e3_stage_local.RingHeadroom's
leaves.cannot_prove: A yield on a ring that is near full (the close is an unscoped command and uses the ordinary writable-slot check)

leaves.name: refused-bulk-allocation
leaves.replaces: KVCacheManager.allocate_slots returning None (no free blocks) for the bulk's reopen
leaves.equivalence: The pinned allocate_slots contract: None means the allocation is refused and nothing is allocated; the real controller then refuses the admission and nothing is parked; every other request allocates through the rig's manager
leaves.cannot_prove: Why a box allocation would refuse (block pressure, eviction state)

leaves.name: paused-core-schedules-nothing
leaves.replaces: EngineCore stepping a PAUSED_ALL scheduler (no schedule(), so no flash_s5_admit seam)
leaves.equivalence: Scheduler.get_num_unfinished_requests returns 0 under PAUSED_ALL (scheduler.py:2826) and schedule() gives no budget (scheduler.py:648); the policy pauses the core before every rollback, as on the frozen auto-arm refused path; the rig reaches the admission seam only while core.paused is False
leaves.cannot_prove: An EngineCore step that runs schedule() while paused (not in the pinned source)

leaves.name: free-block-check
leaves.replaces: KVCacheCoordinator.get_num_blocks_to_allocate, BlockPool.get_num_free_blocks and KVCacheManager.watermark_blocks as the candidate rule and auto-arm _plan read them
leaves.equivalence: The pinned arithmetic: one block per uncached token (num_tokens - total_computed_tokens), a settable free-block count and watermark 0; the candidate refuses when needed + watermark exceeds free, as the real check does
leaves.cannot_prove: The box block size, hybrid Mamba/attention group arithmetic and the real free count under load

leaves.name: profile-query
leaves.replaces: The stepped (unfused) QSA path's active-stage profile query (stage 0, layer 0, stage-0 ranks) that _drive would have sent before _refuse_profile
leaves.equivalence: The driver's own _refuse_profile runs on the real yield state; only the query record it reads is set by the test; the worker-side profile agreement is test_e3_native_schedule_profile's
leaves.cannot_prove: Whether a box profile disagreement occurs during an append chunk at all

leaves.name: profile-failure-publication
leaves.replaces: vllm.v1.request.RequestStatus, vllm.v1.engine output types and Scheduler.finish_requests(FINISHED_ERROR) on the embedding-core failure route
leaves.equivalence: The types are constructed, never read; finish_requests removes the request from its queue, requests and worker rows as the stock abort leaf does
leaves.cannot_prove: The client-visible error output and the real scheduler's finish bookkeeping

leaves.name: refused-append-allocation
leaves.replaces: KVCacheManager.allocate_slots returning None for the append after a given number of granted chunks
leaves.equivalence: The pinned allocate_slots contract: None means refused and nothing allocated; the real controller then refuses the admission and parks nothing; every other request allocates through the rig manager
leaves.cannot_prove: Why a box allocation would refuse between the candidate check and the admission (prefix-cache change, block pressure)

leaves.name: engine-step-order
leaves.replaces: One EngineCore step: executor_hooks' policy tick, the driver tick, worker completions, the scheduler admission seam when unpaused, and stock's own step serving the one-token handback when the hold releases it
leaves.equivalence: The same call order the engine makes each step, counted in steps (no clock); the handback is served only when the real hold (defer_stock_positive_frontier) does not hold the append and the route is FULL
leaves.cannot_prove: Box step timing, batch composition and how many engine steps a real handback takes

leaves.name: close-refused-ack
leaves.replaces: A worker's flash_s5_cancel reply that accepts the close but reports the row not closed, on every round
leaves.equivalence: A typed CancelAck from one rank with an empty closed set; the driver reads it through its frozen apply path as any reply
leaves.cannot_prove: Whether a box rank can keep a row open under a close; the existing fail-closed raise is the recorded outcome

leaves.name: aborted-append-frontier
leaves.replaces: An append stopped mid-prefill by the abort rule (a profile refusal, the stale guard) and still in the scheduler in the FULL window: its frontier set back so more than one prompt token is left
leaves.equivalence: The same request object in the same queue with num_computed_tokens below num_tokens - 1, the state the abort rule leaves; the hold and the window read only those fields
leaves.cannot_prove: Which frontier a box abort leaves, or how often a profile refusal hits an append (unreachable with fused QSA selected)

leaves.name: stock-running-prefill-chunk
leaves.replaces: Stock's own step scheduling a decoder's running prefill chunk to completion during the re-entry's drain wait
leaves.equivalence: Applied only while the core is unpaused and the real hold (defer_stock_running_prefill) releases the request; the chunk end sets num_computed_tokens to num_tokens as a stock step does
leaves.cannot_prove: How many box steps the chunk takes, or that one pass suffices for a long prompt (the retries stay bounded either way)

leaves.name: driver-kind-switch
leaves.replaces: The engine choosing its segment driver at startup (s5_startup: StagedSegmentDriver with FLASH_S5_STAGE_LOCAL=1, the box setting; NativeSegmentDriver otherwise). The tests switch the class attribute Rig.DRIVER ('native' or 'staged'; the StagedDriver mixin, StagedIdentity.run_both, StagedMutants)
leaves.equivalence: Rig builds the real driver class the startup would pick for that setting over the same real controller, auto-arm policy and four bridge workers; the attribute picks the class and nothing else (each case asserts type(rig.d))
leaves.cannot_prove: The startup path itself (covered by the s5_startup suites), CUDA work
